name: Financial Event Canonicalizer
responsibility: Construct the canonical FinancialExecutionEvent from admissible source inputs without assigning execution authority.

name: Authority Binding Resolver
responsibility: Resolve and bind upstream authority references to the specific financial execution event, scope, principal, and execution context.

name: Current Admissibility Evaluator
responsibility: Evaluate whether current authority, policy, resource, dependency, jurisdiction, and execution state satisfy the admission requirements at a consequential boundary.

name: Consequential Boundary Controller
responsibility: Prevent financially consequential effectuation unless current admission has been established.

name: Effect Outcome Classifier
responsibility: Classify execution outcome as NO-EFFECT, PARTIAL, COMPLETED, or INDETERMINATE.

name: Partial-Effect Detector
responsibility: Detect whether only a strict subset of the intended economic effect has occurred.

name: Settlement State Controller
responsibility: Maintain canonical settlement lifecycle state without collapsing partial, completed, reconciled, final, or indeterminate outcomes.

name: Compensation Requirement Assessor
responsibility: Determine whether compensation is structurally required without granting compensation authority.

name: Compensation Admission Controller
responsibility: Require independent authority and current admissibility for every CompensationInstruction.

name: Reversal Eligibility Assessor
responsibility: Determine whether a reversal mechanism structurally exists without granting reversal authority.

name: Reversal Admission Controller
responsibility: Require independent authority and current admissibility before any reversal execution.

name: Financial Reconciliation Engine
responsibility: Reconcile observed effects, obligations, resource states, evidence, and participating state into a determinate reconciled financial state where possible.

name: Financial Reconstruction Engine
responsibility: Reconstruct historical financial execution state from preserved evidence and provenance without representing reconstruction as uninterrupted continuity.

name: Finality Classifier
responsibility: Classify financial state as PROVISIONAL, FINAL, REVERSIBLE, or IRREVERSIBLE according to explicit finality semantics.

name: Economic Continuity Classifier
responsibility: Classify financial execution continuity independently from completion, balance equivalence, and settlement finality.

name: Financial Evidence Recorder
responsibility: Record append-only execution, refusal, effect, reconciliation, finality, and reconstruction evidence.

name: Multi-Party Authority Reconciler
responsibility: Resolve and compare authority and execution constraints across multiple participating institutions or actors without inferring global authority from participation.

name: Distributed Settlement Coordinator
responsibility: Coordinate multi-party settlement state while preserving participant-specific authority, dependency, and unresolved-state distinctions.

name: Ledger Admission Adapter
responsibility: Map ledger-valid transactions into the financial governance admission model without equating ledger validity with authority.

name: Consensus Authority Separator
responsibility: Maintain explicit distinction between consensus state, technical validity, and governance authority.

name: Custody Authority Controller
responsibility: Separate custody, key possession, wallet control, ownership, and current execution authority.

name: Programmable Execution Admission Gateway
responsibility: Evaluate smart-contract or programmable financial execution against current authority and admissibility independently from code validity.

name: Oracle State Integrity Resolver
responsibility: Resolve oracle currentness, provenance, integrity, and dependency status without treating oracle data as authority.

name: Jurisdiction State Resolver
responsibility: Determine the jurisdiction state applicable at the current consequential execution boundary.

name: Jurisdiction Conflict Controller
responsibility: Detect unresolved conflicting jurisdictional constraints and prevent silent permissive collapse.

name: Economic Principal Resolver
responsibility: Resolve the authoritative principal or recognized authority source behind machine-originated financial execution.

name: Delegated Economic Authority Controller
responsibility: Enforce delegation attenuation and prevent autonomous expansion of financial authority.

name: Machine-Originated Execution Controller
responsibility: Require machine-originated financial actions to traverse the same authority, admissibility, boundary, evidence, and settlement requirements as other consequential executions.
primary_outputs: Execution request into canonical financial pipeline
